Jules (Sales): heads up — Prospect Alpha hitting frequent SSE parse errors during POC demo. App logs: 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. Seen on Chrome + Safari mobile, behind corporate proxy.

Sam (SE): quick q: which SDK and can you paste raw event fragments from Network tab?

Jules (Sales): They used CDN version of our client. Raw snippet (redacted):
```
data: {\"id\":\"a1\",\"frag\":\"{\\\"reply\\\":\\\"Hello, wor\"\n
```
then next event:
```
data: {\"id\":\"a1\",\"frag\":\"ld!\\\"}\n
```
Client did JSON.parse per event and crashed when fragments split multi-byte chars.

Pri (Client Eng): this matches proxy gzip/transform behavior. If proxy adds `content-encoding: gzip` it can re-chunk or coalesce in ways that split SSE event bodies. Did they see `content-encoding` in curl?

Jules (Sales): I'll ask them for curl -N output. They said it happened ~30% of streams, more on mobile.

Sam (SE): Triage checklist to send: 1) curl -N -v https://api.redwood.test/stream/<id> and paste raw output, 2) check headers for `content-encoding` and `content-type`, 3) try toggling `transport: 'websocket'` in SDK for demo, 4) try our newer SDK patch with incremental UTF-8 buffering.

Pri (Client Eng): For immediate demo fallback, websocket is easiest (wss on 443). No infra change for hosted. If they can't use ws, client-side reassembly works: accumulate fragments per id and only JSON.parse when you detect complete payload (brace-count or id marker). I'll DM them a tiny snippet.

Jules (Sales): any special notes for their security team re: websockets? They worry about open ports.

Sam (SE): Websockets use TLS wss:// over 443 — standard in corporate environments. For Dedicated we might need to confirm allowed ports but usually it's fine. Auth and audit logging still apply same as SSE.

ops-bot: Deployed stream-fixes v2027.05.03 by @sam — includes client decoder fix and SDK patch.

Pri (Client Eng): I'll send the reassembly snippet + ws toggle. Also ask them to share HAR if issue persists.

Jules (Sales): I'll ask for curl + HAR and offer ws fallback for the next-demo. Will update. Thanks team :thumbsup:
